heading: It's Time to Trust Americans Again.
text: Washington has forgotten who it's supposed to serve. I believe government should trust Americans more than Washington trusts itself. Together, we can restore constitutional government, protect individual liberty, and return power where it belongs—with the people.

heading: It's Time to Trust Americans Again.
text: Navy Veteran • Father • Public Servant • Constitutional Libertarian

heading: Why I'm Running
text: For twenty years, I had the privilege of serving our nation in the United States Navy. After retiring, I chose a different kind of service—raising my children, giving back to my community, and continuing to learn and grow as a husband, father, and citizen.

heading: Why I'm Running
text: I never planned to run for Congress. Like many Americans, I believed that if I worked hard, raised my family, and did my part, I could make a difference where I lived. But over time, I watched Washington become more focused on growing its own power than serving the people who entrusted it with that responsibility.

heading: Why I'm Running
text: That's why I'm running. I believe government should trust Americans more than Washington trusts itself. I believe the Constitution still matters, individual liberty is worth protecting, and public office is an opportunity to serve—not to rule.

heading: Why I'm Running
text: I’m not running to become a career politician. I’m running to be your representative.

heading: There Is Another Way.
text: For too long, Americans have been told they have only two choices: bigger government from one party or bigger government from the other. I don't believe that's the future our Founders envisioned, and I don't believe it's the future the American people deserve.

heading: There Is Another Way.
text: There is another way—one that trusts the people, respects the Constitution, protects individual liberty, and expects government to live within the limits placed on it by the people it serves.

heading: There Is Another Way.
text: This campaign isn't about left versus right. It's about restoring the principles that made America strong: personal responsibility, equal justice under the law, fiscal responsibility, and the freedom to build your own future.

heading: There Is Another Way.
text: "Freedom isn't Left or Right. It's American."

heading: There Is Another Way.
text: Government exists because of the people. It answers to the people. And it should always serve the people.

heading: There Is Another Way.
text: That principle shaped our founding documents. It should still guide our government today.

heading: Your Money
text: Lower taxes. Responsible spending. End government waste.

heading: Your Freedom
text: Defend the Constitution. Protect individual liberty. Limit federal overreach.

heading: Your Vote
text: Honest representation. Transparent government. Every voice matters.

heading: Meet Brian
text: I am a Navy veteran, a father, and a citizen who believes public office should be about service—not power.

heading: 20 Years in the U.S. Navy
text: Twenty years of service taught me leadership, discipline, accountability, and the importance of putting the mission before personal ambition.

heading: Father of Three
text: Raising my children has made the future of this country personal. Our children deserve more freedom, greater opportunity, and a government that lives within its means.

heading: Constitution First
text: The Constitution limits the government, not the citizen. Every vote I cast will begin with one question: Is this constitutional?

heading: Citizen Legislator
text: Congress should be filled with citizens who serve for a time—not politicians who build lifelong careers in Washington. I will serve, remain accountable, and come home.

heading: Highlighted Issues
text: Campaign promises should be clear before Election Day. Here are some of the issues that matter most to me and the people of our district.

heading: Fiscal Responsibility
text: Washington does not have a revenue problem—it has a spending problem. I will fight for balanced budgets, honest accounting, and an end to reckless spending that leaves our children with the bill.

heading: Constitutional Government
text: Government must operate within its constitutional limits, remain transparent, and answer to the people it serves.

heading: Veterans
text: Veterans earned their benefits through service and sacrifice. I will fight for greater choice, less bureaucracy, real accountability, and care that puts the veteran first.

heading: Fiscal Responsibility
text: Washington doesn't have a revenue problem—it has a spending problem. Every dollar the federal government wastes is a dollar taken from hardworking Americans or borrowed from future generations.

heading: America's Greatest National Security Threat
text: America's national debt has become the single greatest long-term threat to our national security. A nation buried beneath trillions of dollars in debt cannot remain economically strong, strategically independent, or leave future generations the country they deserve.

heading: America's Greatest National Security Threat
text: Every dollar Washington borrows today is a bill sent to our children tomorrow. We cannot continue spending money we do not have while expecting future Americans to bear the burden.

heading: America's Greatest National Security Threat
text: Fiscal responsibility is not simply about balancing numbers on a ledger. It is about preserving America's independence, protecting our economic future, and honoring our obligation to leave the next generation a stronger nation than the one we inherited.

heading: Why This Matters
text: The national debt continues to grow while Congress spends money it doesn't have. Inflation has quietly reduced the purchasing power of every American family.

heading: Why This Matters
text: Government should live within its means just like the people it represents. Families balance budgets every day. Washington should be expected to do the same.

heading: Pass a Balanced Budget
text: Congress should be required to live within its means just as American families do.

heading: Confront the National Debt
text: America's national debt has become the single greatest long-term threat to our national security and the future prosperity of our children.

heading: End Reckless Spending
text: Washington must stop spending money it doesn't have and adding to the national debt.

heading: Stop Inflationary Money Printing
text: Printing trillions of dollars devalues every paycheck and every retirement account.

heading: Audit Federal Agencies
text: Every federal agency should be accountable for how it spends taxpayer dollars.

heading: Eliminate Unconstitutional Bureaucracies
text: Agencies that exceed the powers granted by the Constitution should be reduced or eliminated.

heading: Hold Congress Accountable
text: Members of Congress should be held responsible for the nation's fiscal health, not rewarded for reckless spending.

heading: Protect Future Generations
text: Restore fiscal responsibility so our children inherit opportunity instead of crushing debt.

heading: The Bottom Line
text: Fiscal responsibility isn't just about balancing numbers on a spreadsheet. It's about honoring the trust taxpayers place in their government. Every dollar Washington spends was earned by someone who worked for it.

heading: The Bottom Line
text: We can restore accountability, reduce waste, and build a government that lives within its means. That's how we protect both our economy and the future of our children.

heading: Government Accountability
text: Congress and federal agencies must answer to the Constitution and the people they serve.

heading: Energy Independence
text: Affordable, reliable American energy strengthens families, businesses, and national security.

heading: Individual Liberty
text: Your earnings, choices, and future should not be controlled by an oversized federal government.

heading: Individual Liberty
text: Every American is born with rights. Government does not create those rights, and it should not take them away.

heading: Why This Matters
text: Liberty is not a gift from government. It is the birthright of every American.

heading: Why This Matters
text: Free speech, privacy, property rights, due process, religious liberty, and the right to keep and bear arms are not optional. They are protected by the Constitution and must be defended without apology.

heading: Why This Matters
text: When government treats freedom like a permission slip, it stops serving the people and starts ruling over them.

heading: Defend the Bill of Rights
text: The Bill of Rights is not a list of government privileges. It is a boundary government must not cross.

heading: Protect Free Speech
text: Americans should never fear government punishment for speaking their minds or challenging those in power.

heading: Protect Religious Liberty
text: Government has no authority to dictate matters of conscience, faith, or belief.

heading: Defend the Second Amendment
text: The right to keep and bear arms is a constitutional right and must be protected.

heading: Protect Privacy and Property
text: Americans have the right to be secure in their homes, property, personal data, and private lives.

heading: Oppose Government Overreach
text: Personal decisions should remain with individuals and families, not federal bureaucrats.

heading: The Bottom Line
text: Liberty is not negotiable. It does not belong to the government, and it should never depend on which party is in power.

heading: The Bottom Line
text: Freedom is not Left or Right. It is American.

heading: Government Accountability
text: Government must remain within its constitutional limits and answer to the people it serves.

heading: Second Amendment
text: The right to keep and bear arms is an individual liberty that government must not infringe.

heading: Healthcare Reform
text: Patients should control their healthcare decisions without unnecessary government interference.

heading: Every Legal Vote. Counted Fairly.
text: Election Integrity • Transparency • Public Confidence

heading: Why It Matters
text: Confidence in our elections is essential to preserving our republic. Regardless of political party, every American should trust that elections are conducted fairly, transparently, and according to the law.

heading: Why It Matters
text: Election integrity is not about helping one party or hurting another. It is about ensuring that every eligible citizen has the opportunity to vote, every legal vote is counted accurately, and every election is conducted with transparency and accountability.

heading: Why It Matters
text: Public trust is earned through consistent rules, secure procedures, and open oversight—not political rhetoric.

heading: Where I Stand
text: I support election systems that are secure, transparent, and easy for eligible citizens to use while making fraud difficult to commit and easy to detect.

heading: Where I Stand
text: States should continue leading election administration while Congress respects constitutional limits on federal authority.

heading: Where I Stand
text: Every lawful voter deserves confidence that their vote carries the same weight as every other lawful vote.

heading: Where I Stand
text: Americans should never have to question whether the rules were applied fairly to everyone.

heading: Protect Every Legal Vote
text: Every eligible citizen should be able to vote, and every legal vote should be counted accurately.

heading: Promote Transparency
text: Election processes should be open, observable, and accountable to the public.

heading: Support Secure Elections
text: Election systems should protect against fraud while remaining accessible to lawful voters.

heading: Respect Constitutional Authority
text: Election administration should remain consistent with the Constitution and the role of the states.

heading: Ensure Equal Application of the Law
text: Election laws should be applied fairly and consistently to every voter, every campaign, and every jurisdiction.

heading: Restore Public Confidence
text: Confidence in elections strengthens confidence in our entire constitutional republic.

heading: Bottom Line
text: Our elections should leave Americans with confidence—not doubt. Every eligible citizen deserves the opportunity to vote, and every legal vote deserves to be counted fairly, accurately, and transparently.

heading: Bottom Line
text: Public confidence in our elections strengthens confidence in our republic itself.

heading: Government Accountability
text: Transparent government and meaningful oversight are essential to maintaining public trust.

heading: Individual Liberty
text: Every eligible citizen deserves a secure vote and confidence that their voice will be heard.

heading: Fiscal Responsibility
text: Election systems should protect public trust while using taxpayer resources responsibly.

heading: Constitutional Government
text: The Constitution limits the government—not the people.

heading: Why It Matters
text: The Constitution was not written to control the American people. It was written to limit the power of the federal government and protect the liberty of the people.

heading: Why It Matters
text: When Washington expands beyond its constitutional limits, government becomes less accountable, less transparent, and farther removed from the people it serves.

heading: Where I Stand
text: I believe every bill should begin with one question: does the Constitution authorize the federal government to do this?

heading: Where I Stand
text: Congress must respect the separation of powers, protect the Bill of Rights, review the scope of federal agencies, and return appropriate authority closer to the people and the states.

heading: Begin with the Constitution
text: Every vote I take will begin with whether the Constitution authorizes the federal government to act.

heading: Defend the Bill of Rights
text: The rights of the people are not privileges granted by Washington.

heading: Respect Separation of Powers
text: No branch of government should be allowed to exceed its constitutional role.

heading: Limit Federal Overreach
text: Federal agencies should not exercise powers never granted by the Constitution.

heading: Return Power to the People
text: Government should remain closest to the people whenever possible.

heading: Choose Principle Over Politics
text: My oath is to the Constitution, not to party leaders or political pressure.

heading: Bottom Line
text: The Constitution does not limit freedom. It protects freedom by limiting government.

heading: Bottom Line
text: My responsibility is to the Constitution and to the people of Florida's 14th Congressional District. If political pressure ever conflicts with either, I will choose principle over politics.

heading: Veterans
text: My service didn't end with retirement. It simply gave me a new way to serve.

heading: Why This Matters
text: For twenty years, I wore the uniform of the United States Navy. Retirement didn't end my commitment to serving others—it simply gave me a new way to serve.

heading: Why This Matters
text: Our nation has a solemn obligation to every man and woman who answered the call to defend it. That obligation doesn't end when they take off the uniform.

heading: Why This Matters
text: Keeping our promises to veterans means more than speeches on Veterans Day. It means ensuring we receive the care, respect, and support we've earned through our service.

heading: Why This Matters
text: Veteran suicide isn't just another policy issue to me. Over the years, I’ve received the devastating news that thirteen friends and members of my squadron—people I flew with and turned wrenches beside—lost the battle within.

heading: Why This Matters
text: Those losses are something I carry with me. They remind me that when we ask Americans to wear the uniform, our responsibility to them doesn't end when they take it off. That's why this isn't just another campaign promise for me. It's personal.

heading: My Perspective
text: My experience with the Department of Veterans Affairs has generally been a positive one. I've been fortunate to receive quality care from doctors, nurses, and staff who truly care about veterans.

heading: My Perspective
text: Where I believe we need improvement isn't with the people—it's with the bureaucracy.

heading: My Perspective
text: Too many veterans spend months waiting on claims, navigating unnecessary paperwork, or struggling to access the care they've already earned. We can do better, and we owe it to every man and woman who served.

heading: Protect Earned Benefits
text: Benefits earned through military service should never be treated as political bargaining chips.

heading: Cut VA Bureaucracy
text: Veterans should not have to fight months of paperwork to receive the care and benefits they have earned.

heading: Improve VA Accountability
text: The Department of Veterans Affairs must serve veterans first, not protect broken systems.

heading: Expand Community Care
text: When the VA cannot provide timely treatment, veterans should have access to care in their own communities.

heading: Strengthen Mental Health Support
text: PTSD, suicide prevention, and mental health treatment must be treated with urgency and seriousness.

heading: Respect Veteran Choice
text: Veterans should have access to traditional medicine, community care, mental health support, and complementary, holistic, herbal, and alternative therapies when appropriate in consultation with their healthcare providers.

heading: The Bottom Line
text: No veteran who survived the battlefield should come home and lose the battle within. Every veteran suicide is a tragedy, and one is too many.

heading: The Bottom Line
text: We owe our veterans more than gratitude—we owe them a system that responds quickly, treats them with dignity, and never stops working to ensure every veteran has hope, support, and access to the care they've earned.

heading: The Bottom Line
text: Until veteran suicide is no longer a daily reality, our work is not finished.

heading: My Oath
text: For twenty years, I swore an oath to support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic.

heading: My Oath
text: That oath did not end the day I retired from the United States Navy. It is a promise that continues to guide my life and my service.

heading: My Oath
text: Before I cast a vote, I'll ask one question: Is it constitutional?

heading: National Defense
text: A strong national defense requires responsible leadership and an enduring commitment to those who serve.

heading: Healthcare Reform
text: Veterans and their families deserve timely care, real choices, and a healthcare system focused on patients.

heading: Government Accountability
text: Federal agencies, including the VA, must answer for delays, failures, and the treatment of those they serve.
